# nah_load_balancer_backend (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud load_balancer_backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_load_balancer_backend" "app" {
  project          = "my-app"
  load_balancer_id = "LOAD_BALANCER_ID"
  id               = "BACKEND_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `project` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `healthy` (Boolean)
- `instance_id` (String) Opaque instance ID.
- `port` (Number)
- `weight` (Number)
